findings.message: cmdDevolverComMotivo has no <command>.input state in the definition; added the public draft state cmdDevolverComMotivoDraft (type CmdDevolverComMotivoDraft) with setCmdDevolverComMotivoDraft. The command method takes the task id; the version is read from the loaded pendencias.

The four commands return only resumo and pendencias; avisoHoje (the daily notice) is fed by no command output, so after a task transition it can still list a task whose situation changed. Only the declared outputs were applied; no reload was added.
resumo and pendencias returned by the commands have no command-owned state; they were applied to the states resumo and pendencias (replace), as the route comments say.
public cmdDevolverComMotivoDraft is not declared by the defs; the shared added it so the pages can drive the page (a draft, a setter, a selection or a filter state).
public setCmdDevolverComMotivoDraft is not declared by the defs; the shared added it so the pages can drive the page (a draft, a setter, a selection or a filter state).
